method: Read text blobs by exact SHA; split simple CSV, validate dimensions, numeric nonnegative entries and identifier uniqueness, compare gene and barcode sets. No independently recomputed byte-level hash. No clinical or biological efficacy claim.
limitations: RNA and DNA assays are not paired by matching barcode strings; no identity inference.
No verified matched healthy tissue or donor metadata; cannot test selective cancer killing or regeneration hypothesis.
Published matrices are downstream study data, not original sequencing FASTQs.
No data copied into Python or user repository; audit only.
